lists.name: php
lists.info: 在 Ubuntu Rootfs 中独立安装并运行 PHP CLI，wwwroot 目录会被php、python环境共用，卸载单个环境时不会删除目录本身，只清理自身文件。

install.command: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; apt-get update && apt-get install -y php-cli && mkdir -p '/storage/emulated/0/WebHTV/wwwroot' && printf '%s\n' '<?php echo "Hello from Ubuntu PHP " . PHP_VERSION;' > '/storage/emulated/0/WebHTV/wwwroot/index.php' && touch '{package_dir}/.installed'
install.uninstall_command: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; __p=$(dpkg -l 2>/dev/null | awk '$1 ~ /^i/ || $1=="rc" {print $2}' | grep -E '^php' | tr '\n' ' '); echo "[lab] 待卸载 php 包: ${__p:-（无）}"; [ -n "$__p" ] && apt-get purge -y $__p; apt-get autoremove -y; rm -f '/storage/emulated/0/WebHTV/wwwroot/index.php'; rm -f '{package_dir}/.installed'; if command -v php >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '[lab] php 仍在 rootfs，卸载未完成'; false; else echo '[lab] php 已从 rootfs 移除'; true; fi
install.reset_command: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; __p=$(dpkg -l 2>/dev/null | awk '$1 ~ /^i/ || $1=="rc" {print $2}' | grep -E '^php' | tr '\n' ' '); [ -n "$__p" ] && apt-get purge -y $__p; apt-get autoremove -y >/dev/null 2>&1; rm -f '{package_dir}/.installed'; true

lists.name: nodejs
lists.info: 在 Ubuntu Rootfs 中独立安装并运行 Node.js。 ｜ arm64/amd64 → NodeSource 官方源 (Node 24)；32 位 ARM（armv7/armhf）→ 官方 armv7l 二进制 (Node 22 LTS)，已内置 libatomic1 依赖 + npm 兜底 + 安装后自检

install.command: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; ARCH=$(dpkg --print-architecture); echo "[lab] 架构: $ARCH"; mkdir -p /tmp && chmod 1777 /tmp; apt-get update; apt-get install -y curl ca-certificates xz-utils gnupg libatomic1 libstdc++6; if [ "$ARCH" = "arm64" ] || [ "$ARCH" = "amd64" ]; then echo "[lab] $ARCH: 走 NodeSource 官方源 (Node 24)"; curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_24.x | bash - && apt-get install -y nodejs; else echo "[lab] $ARCH: NodeSource 不提供 32 位 ARM 包，改用官方 armv7l 二进制 (Node 22 LTS)"; F=$(curl -fsSL https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/nodejs/latest-v22.x/ | grep -oE 'node-v[0-9.]+-linux-armv7l\.tar\.xz' | sort -V | tail -1); case "$F" in ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9._-]*) F=node-v22.22.3-linux-armv7l.tar.xz;; esac; echo "[lab] 下载 $F"; (curl -fL --retry 3 -o /tmp/node.tar.xz "https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/nodejs/latest-v22.x/$F" || curl -fL --retry 3 -o /tmp/node.tar.xz "https://registry.npmmirror.com/-/binary/node/latest-v22.x/$F") && tar -xJf /tmp/node.tar.xz -C /usr/local --strip-components=1 && rm -f /tmp/node.tar.xz; command -v ldconfig >/dev/null 2>&1 && ldconfig >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; if ! command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then ln -sf /usr/local/lib/node_modules/npm/bin/npm-cli.js /usr/local/bin/npm 2>/dev/null; ln -sf /usr/local/lib/node_modules/npm/bin/npx-cli.js /usr/local/bin/npx 2>/dev/null; fi; if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then npm config set registry https://registry.npmmirror.com >/dev/null 2>&1; npm install -g npm@latest >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "[lab] ⚠️ npm 升级失败（不影响使用）"; npm config set registry https://registry.npmmirror.com >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; echo "===== nodejs 环境自检 ====="; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "[lab] ❌ node 未安装到 PATH"; exit 1; }; echo "[lab] node 路径: $(command -v node)"; node --version || { echo "[lab] ❌ node 无法运行（armv7l 常见原因：缺 libatomic1，执行 apt-get install -y libatomic1）"; exit 1; }; if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "[lab] npm 路径: $(command -v npm)"; npm --version; else echo "[lab] ⚠️ npm 不可用"; fi; node -e 'console.log("[lab] node 自检 OK")'; touch '{package_dir}/.installed'; echo "[lab] ✅ nodejs 环境就绪"
install.uninstall_command: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; __p=$(dpkg -l 2>/dev/null | awk '$1 ~ /^i/ || $1=="rc" {print $2}' | grep -E '^node' | tr '\n' ' '); echo "[lab] 待卸载 node 包: ${__p:-（无）}"; [ -n "$__p" ] && apt-get purge -y $__p; apt-get autoremove -y; rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/nodesource.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d/nodesource.sources /etc/apt/keyrings/nodesource.gpg /usr/share/keyrings/nodesource.gpg; rm -rf /usr/lib/node_modules /usr/local/lib/node_modules /root/.npm /root/.node-gyp; rm -f '{package_dir}/.installed'; if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '[lab] node 仍在 rootfs，卸载未完成'; false; else echo '[lab] node 已从 rootfs 移除'; true; fi
install.reset_command: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; __p=$(dpkg -l 2>/dev/null | awk '$1 ~ /^i/ || $1=="rc" {print $2}' | grep -E '^node' | tr '\n' ' '); [ -n "$__p" ] && apt-get purge -y $__p; apt-get autoremove -y >/dev/null 2>&1; rm -f '{package_dir}/.installed'; true
